_readme: Meridian execution config. Default is signals-only: signals are displayed, nothing is submitted.
The credential comes from process.env.OANDA. It is never read from this file.
Every setting below is either OWNER (the owner supplied it) or TEST (a labelled test value).
The TEST profile is used only when useTestProfile is true, and every value it supplies is
labelled TEST in the execution record and on the dashboard. The owner overrides any of them
by adding the same key under ownerSettings, which takes precedence and is labelled OWNER.
There is no setting here that can change the trading host: the host is a frozen constant in
lib/interlock.ts and the order path asserts it on every request.
